examples.chinese: 我弟弟是小學四年級的學生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi shì xiǎoxué sì niánjí de xuéshēng.
examples.english: My younger brother is a fourth-grade elementary school student.

examples.chinese: 我們從小學到大學都是同學，也是很好的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen cóng xiǎoxué dào dàxué dōu shì tóngxué, yě shì hěn hǎo de péngyǒu.
examples.english: From elementary school to university, we have always been classmates and also very good friends.

examples.chinese: 這些帶子是我小學的記錄，我請朋友把它存進電腦裡。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dàizi shì wǒ xiǎoxué de jìlù, wǒ qǐng péngyǒu bǎ tā cún jìn diànnǎo lǐ.
examples.english: These tapes are records from my elementary school days; I asked a friend to save them onto the computer.

examples.chinese: 以前我的小學老師總是親切地教導我們，讓我到現在還是很懷念她。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ de xiǎoxué lǎoshī zǒngshì qīnqiè de jiàodǎo wǒmen, ràng wǒ dào xiànzài háishì hěn huáiniàn tā.
examples.english: My elementary school teacher used to teach us kindly, which makes me still cherish her memory even now.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的小學教導孩子從平常生活中學習遵守規定。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de xiǎoxué jiàodǎo háizi cóng píngcháng shēnghuó zhōng xuéxí zūnshǒu guīdìng.
examples.english: Elementary schools in Taiwan teach children to learn to comply with rules in their daily lives.

examples.chinese: 我在公車站等了一會兒，公車就來了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài gōngchēzhàn děng le yīhuìr, gōngchē jiù lái le.
examples.english: I waited at the bus stop for a while, and then the bus came.

examples.chinese: 窗外正下著大雨，我又沒帶傘，看來得在公司多留一會兒了。
examples.pinyin: Chuāngwài zhèng xiàzhe dàyǔ, wǒ yòu méi dài sǎn, kànlái děi zài gōngsī duō liú yīhuìr le.
examples.english: It's raining heavily outside the window, and I didn't bring an umbrella, so it seems that I'll have to stay at the office a while longer.

examples.chinese: 等一會兒開會時麻煩你負責打字，把開會的內容記錄下來。
examples.pinyin: Děng yīhuìr kāihuì shí máfan nǐ fùzé dǎzì, bǎ kāihuì de nèiróng jìlù xiàlái.
examples.english: When the meeting starts in a moment, please be responsible for typing and record the meeting content.

examples.chinese: 對上班族來說，上網買牙刷、內衣褲、面紙等日用品，既輕鬆又方便。
examples.pinyin: Duì shàngbānzú lái shuō, shàngwǎng mǎi yáshuā, nèiyīkù, miànzhǐ děng rìyòngpǐn, jì qīngsōng yòu fāngbiàn.
examples.english: For office workers, buying daily commodities such as toothbrushes, underwear, and tissues online is both relaxing and convenient.

examples.chinese: 台灣南部地區的天氣比北部好。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù dìqū de tiānqì bǐ běibù hǎo.
examples.english: The weather in the southern region of Taiwan is better than in the north.

examples.chinese: 那個地區昨天夜裡突然停水、停電，還好今天中午就恢復正常了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge dìqū zuótiān yèlǐ tūrán tíngshuǐ, tíngdiàn, hái hǎo jīntiān zhōngwǔ jiù huīfù zhèngcháng le.
examples.english: That area suddenly had a water cut and power outage last night, but fortunately it returned to normal by noon today.

examples.chinese: 這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bèi táifēng pòhuài de xiāngdāng yánzhòng, bùshì shùmù dǎo le, jiùshì wūdǐng bèi chuī zǒu le, qíngkuàng fēicháng zāogāo.
examples.english: This area was damaged quite severely by the typhoon; either trees fell down or roofs were blown away—the situation is very bad.

examples.chinese: 這個地區是個危險地帶，因為經常一下雨就有石頭掉下來，有時候連路都會塌了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū shì ge wēixiǎn dìdài, yīnwèi jīngcháng yí xià yǔ jiù yǒu shítou diào xiàlái, yǒu shíhou lián lù dōu huì tā le.
examples.english: This area is a dangerous zone, because whenever it rains, rocks often fall, and sometimes even the road collapses.

examples.chinese: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.
examples.english: Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working.

examples.chinese: 這個城市一連下了五天的雨，造成很多地區淹水，三分之一的路不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yīlián xià le wǔ tiān de yǔ, zàochéng hěnduō dìqū yānshuǐ, sān fēn zhī yī de lù bù tōng le.
examples.english: It rained for five days in a row in this city, causing flooding in many areas, and one third of the roads are impassable.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的地形有三分之一是平原，三分之二是高山。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de dìxíng yǒu sān fēn zhī yī shì píngyuán, sān fēn zhī èr shì gāoshān.
examples.english: One third of the landscape in this area is plains, and two thirds are high mountains.

examples.chinese: 為了偏僻地區孩子的教育，有十幾位老師願意上山下海，到山上、海邊的學校教書。
examples.pinyin: Wèile piānpì dìqū háizi de jiàoyù, yǒu shí jǐ wèi lǎoshī yuànyì shàngshānxiàhǎi, dào shānshàng, hǎibiān de xuéxiào jiāoshū.
examples.english: For the education of children in remote areas, more than ten teachers are willing to go everywhere, to schools in the mountains and by the sea, to teach.

examples.chinese: 這個地區不僅沒有地震、颱風，而且天氣好、空氣新鮮，生活環境安全又舒適。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bùjǐn méiyǒu dìzhèn, táifēng, érqiě tiānqì hǎo, kōngqì xīnxiān, shēnghuó huánjìng ānquán yòu shūshì.
examples.english: This area not only has no earthquakes or typhoons, but also has good weather and fresh air; the living environment is safe and comfortable.

examples.chinese: 這家電腦公司本來只服務亞洲地區的民眾，現在服務範圍已經擴大到歐洲了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diànnǎo gōngsī běnlái zhǐ fúwù Yàzhōu dìqū de mínzhòng, xiànzài fúwù fànwéi yǐjīng kuòdà dào Ōuzhōu le.
examples.english: This computer company originally only served people in the Asian region, but now its service range has already expanded to Europe.

examples.chinese: 前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān yīnwèi táifēng de guānxì, zàochéng bùfèn dìqū yánzhòng yānshuǐ, xǔduō shūguǒ de jiàgé dōu biàn gāo le.
examples.english: A few days ago, because of the typhoon, some areas suffered severe flooding, and the prices of many vegetables and fruits have gone up.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的交通非常混亂，尤其是車多人多的上下班時間。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de jiāotōng fēicháng hùnluàn, yóuqí shì chē duō rén duō de shàngxiàbān shíjiān.
examples.english: The traffic in this area is very chaotic, especially during rush hour when there are many cars and people.

examples.chinese: 教授打算向學校申請一筆經費，進行高山地區的調查計畫。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu dǎsuàn xiàng xuéxiào shēnqǐng yī bǐ jīngfèi, jìnxíng gāoshān dìqū de diàochá jìhuà.
examples.english: The professor plans to apply to the school for a sum of funding to carry out a survey project in the high mountain areas.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風可能帶來大量雨水，地形較低的地區應該多注意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng kěnéng dàilái dàliàng yǔshuǐ, dìxíng jiào dī de dìqū yīnggāi duō zhùyì.
examples.english: This typhoon may bring a great amount of rain, so areas with lower terrain should pay more attention.

examples.chinese: 在交通不方便的地區上班，得一大早就出門才行。
examples.pinyin: Zài jiāotōng bù fāngbiàn de dìqū shàngbān, děi yīdàzǎo jiù chūmén cái xíng.
examples.english: To work in an area with inconvenient transportation, you have to leave early in the morning.

examples.chinese: 在地理條件好的地區，不但農產品種類較多，價格也便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zài dìlǐ tiáojiàn hǎo de dìqū, bùdàn nóngchǎnpǐn zhǒnglèi jiào duō, jiàgé yě piányi.
examples.english: In areas with good geographical conditions, not only are there more types of agricultural produce, but the prices are also cheaper.

examples.chinese: 在這個地區，山地是最主要的地形，因此人口較少。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège dìqū, shāndì shì zuì zhǔyào de dìxíng, yīncǐ rénkǒu jiào shǎo.
examples.english: In this region, mountainous terrain is the most dominant landform; therefore, the population is relatively small.

examples.chinese: 這家醫院每個月都到鄉下地區免費為老人門診。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn měi ge yuè dōu dào xiāngxià dìqū miǎnfèi wèi lǎorén ménzhěn.
examples.english: This hospital goes to rural areas every month to provide free outpatient service for the elderly.

examples.chinese: 我很少到這個地區，所以對附近的路沒什麼印象。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn shǎo dào zhège dìqū, suǒyǐ duì fùjìn de lù méi shénme yìnxiàng.
examples.english: I rarely come to this area, so I don't have much impression of the roads nearby.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的路規劃得不太理想，不僅沒有一條是直的，方向也有點兒亂，很容易就迷路了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dìqū de lù guīhuà de bú tài lǐxiǎng, bùjǐn méiyǒu yì tiáo shì zhí de, fāngxiàng yě yǒudiǎnr luàn, hěn róngyì jiù mílù le.
examples.english: The roads in this area are not planned very ideally; not only is there not a single straight one, but the directions are also a bit chaotic, so it's easy to get lost.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了嚴重的流行病，使人民受到相當大的生活壓力。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le yánzhòng de liúxíngbìng, shǐ rénmín shòudào xiāngdāng dà de shēnghuó yālì.
examples.english: A serious epidemic broke out in the Asian region, causing people to receive considerable life pressure.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了戰爭，使人民生活上所受的的壓力相當大。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le zhànzhēng, shǐ rénmín shēnghuó shàng suǒ shòu de yālì xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: War broke out in the Asian region, causing the pressure that people received in life to be considerable.

examples.chinese: 他雖然年紀小，但是對人有禮貌，也很體貼父母，是個乖孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì xiǎo, dànshì duì rén yǒu lǐmào, yě hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, shì ge guāi háizi.
examples.english: Although he is young, he is polite to people and also very considerate of his parents; he is a well-behaved child.

examples.chinese: 我家的狗很乖，從不破壞家裡的東西。颱風快來了，破壞了我本來要去露營的計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de gǒu hěn guāi, cóng bù pòhuài jiālǐ de dōngxī. Táifēng kuài lái le, pòhuài le wǒ běnlái yào qù lùyíng de jìhuà.
examples.english: Our dog is very well-behaved and never destroys things in the house. The typhoon is coming soon, and it destroyed my original plan to go camping.

examples.chinese: 有一些病人不肯乖乖吃藥，護理師得有耐心，慢慢地跟他們講道理。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē bìngrén bù kěn guāiguāi chī yào, hùlǐshī děi yǒu nàixīn, mànman de gēn tāmen jiǎng dàolǐ.
examples.english: Some patients refuse to take their medicine obediently, so nurses must have patience and slowly reason with them.

examples.chinese: 警察亮出證件，叫那個正在吸毒的人乖乖把毒品交出來。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá liàng chū zhèngjiàn, jiào nàge zhèngzài xīdú de rén guāiguāi bǎ dúpǐn jiāo chūlái.
examples.english: The police officer showed his ID and told the person who was taking drugs to obediently hand over the drugs.

items.wordHook: The 千(thousand) sits calmly atop 北(north); that quiet order means 乖(well-behaved).

examples.chinese: 華人過新年時，如果到好友家拜訪，都會帶著禮物。
examples.pinyin: Huárén guò xīnnián shí, rúguǒ dào hǎoyǒu jiā bàifǎng, dōu huì dàizhe lǐwù.
examples.english: When Chinese people celebrate the New Year, if they pay a visit to a good friend's home, they always bring gifts.

examples.chinese: 這個旅行團的目的地是中國北京(Beijing)，旅客目的是參觀古蹟及拜訪朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǚxíngtuán de mùdìdì shì Zhōngguó Běijīng, lǚkè mùdì shì cānguān gǔjì jí bàifǎng péngyǒu.
examples.english: The destination of this tour group is Beijing, China; the travelers' purpose is to visit historical sites and visit friends.

examples.chinese: 那件事我已經跟你重複說過好多次了，你怎麼還問我？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn shì wǒ yǐjīng gēn nǐ chóngfù shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme hái wèn wǒ?
examples.english: I have already said that matter to you repeatedly many times; how come you are still asking me?

examples.chinese: 這本小說的內容重複性太高，一點新鮮感都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō de nèiróng chóngfùxìng tài gāo, yìdiǎn xīnxiāngǎn dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: The content of this novel is too repetitive; it has no freshness at all.

examples.chinese: 這個字不好念，我重複了好幾次，同學都說不對，害我好想放棄。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zì bù hǎo niàn, wǒ chóngfù le hǎo jǐ cì, tóngxué dōu shuō bù duì, hài wǒ hǎo xiǎng fàngqì.
examples.english: This character is hard to pronounce; I repeated it several times, and my classmates all said it was wrong, which made me really want to give up.

examples.chinese: 有人說好看的人像花瓶，好看卻沒有用，這句話我完全不同意。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō hǎokàn de rén xiàng huāpíng, hǎokàn què méiyǒu yòng, zhè jù huà wǒ wánquán bù tóngyì.
examples.english: Some people say that good-looking people are like flower vases—good-looking but useless; I completely disagree with this statement.

examples.chinese: 個人在使用各式各樣的網路服務時，也應該注意隱私問題。
examples.pinyin: Gèrén zài shǐyòng gè shì gè yàng de wǎnglù fúwù shí, yě yīnggāi zhùyì yǐnsī wèntí.
examples.english: When individuals use various kinds of internet services, they should also pay attention to privacy issues.

items.wordHook: A 麻(hemp) cloth is rubbed by a 手(hand) to scour a surface clean → 摩(scour).
An 牛(ox) drags a 勿(do not) sign across the field → one heavy 物(thing).
A towering stack of golden 禾(grain) balanced with thoughtful 心(heart) stays completely 穩(steady).
Combining 設(build) and 計(calculate): 設計 means design.
Stepping forward with steady 辶(movement) while carrying an armful of grain 啇(stalk) to find an exact 適(match).
